subject: Commitment split & credit vesting plan for Brightlane
messages:
From: Emma Liu <emma@brightlane.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Exploring a 12 vs 24m advance commitment + credits

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for the product demo last week — the latency improvements on the small models look very promising for our chat flows. As we discussed, Brightlane (seed, series A close Q1) is trying to lock predictable pricing for the next 12–24 months while keeping burn comfortable.

Quick context: Q2 usage broke higher than expected due to a marketing campaign (attached Q2 usage summary). We expect month-to-month growth but can commit to a prepay if the structure has:
- a meaningful term discount for 24m vs 12m
- a ramped minimum (starter credit that vests as we hit usage milestones) rather than an immediate sunk prepay
- an option to convert unused prepaid credits into service credits for RD (not refunds)

Could you sketch what a 12-month and a 24-month option might look like (discounts, payment schedule, credit vesting)? Also: any minimum commit thresholds you require for seed-stage companies?

I'd like to loop in our CFO, Chris, for the finance side — cc'd.

Thanks,
Emma
Founder, Brightlane Labs
emma@brightlane.ai
Attachment: Brightlane_Q2_VM_Usage_Summary.pdf (PDF, 78KB)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Liu <emma@brightlane.ai>, Chris Park <chris@brightlane.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Exploring a 12 vs 24m advance commitment + credits

Emma / Chris — great to meet you both. Appreciate the usage detail, it helps a lot. Attached is a starter termsheet (v3) that outlines two illustrative paths: a 12-month starter prepay and a 24-month growth prepay. High-level thoughts up front:

12-month starter (option A)
- Total prepay: $120k over 12 months (paid upfront or 2x installment)
- Effective term discount: 10% off list; credits consumed against usage monthly
- Vesting/credit schedule: 25% available at T0, then 25% each quarter (quarterly vesting tied to usage thresholds)
- Ramped minimum: if usage < 60% of expected at quarter checkpoints, leftover credits convert to service credits valid for 6 months (no cash refunds)

24-month growth (option B)
- Total prepay: $200k over 24 months (flexible split — 50/50 or milestone-triggered)
- Effective term discount: 18% off list (net unit cost reduction)
- Vesting: 20% T0, then 15% every quarter for first year, 10% every quarter second year (to encourage consistent consumption)
- Additional runway credits: 5% top-up at signing if Brightlane hits Series A milestone within 6 months

We'd be happy to model a ramp schedule tied to your monthly MAUs / token spend curve. Karthik (cc) can run a burn/projection to show how credits flow at different growth rates; Aditya will include deal-level pricing & promo considerations.

Quick asks before I draft a redline:
1) Do you prefer single upfront payment, or staged payments tied to milestones?
2) Would the team need monthly invoicing for GAAP?
3) Any regulatory/contract terms we should be aware of re: data locality?

I'll book 30 min for next week to walk through the termsheet — propose Thu 7/30 at 9am PT, open to other times.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Account Exec | Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123
Attachment: Redwood_Starter_Termsheet_v3.pdf (PDF, 48KB)

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 02 Aug 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Commitment guidance for Brightlane (internal)

Vanessa / Aditya — internal note before we finalize terms with the founders. Given Brightlane's seed-stage status and the variability in Q2, recommend we: 
- Offer a more aggressive 24m discount (15-18%) to lock multi-year revenue, but tie a non-refundable portion to milestone-based vesting (protects churn exposure).
- Keep the 12m starter as a lower-risk offer with higher upfront % available immediately (35-50%) and stronger conversion of unused credits into platform service credits (12 month validity).
- Approve a one-time 5% signing top-up if they convert payment from single upfront to two equal installment payments (helps with their cash planning).
- Require minimum committed monthly usage floors starting after month 3 to avoid 'dead credit' accumulation.

If you need a quick legal exception for convertible credit clauses (convert unused prepay to product service credits vs refund), loop in Legal — but I think we can sign off at manager level on the discount schedule.

Evelyn
VP, Commercial
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Commitment split & credit vesting plan for Brightlane

Emma / Chris — thanks for review. Per our internal alignment (cc Evelyn for visibility), here's a concrete two-option offer you can review and sign: 

Option 1 — 12-month Starter (lower upfront, faster vesting)
- Total committed prepay: $100,000
- Payment: two equal installments (30 days apart) OR single upfront (both acceptable)
- Effective discount: 10% off list token rate
- Credit availability: 40% on signing, then 20% at months 3, 6, and 9 (quarterly checkpoints)
- Unused credit treatment: leftover credits convert to Redwood service credits valid for 6 months after term end (no cash refunds)
- Minimum monthly floor: after month 3, must meet 50% of projected monthly usage or Redwood reserves the right to reclassify unused credits as non-refundable platform credits.

Option 2 — 24-month Growth (higher discount, staggered payout)
- Total committed prepay: $220,000
- Payment: staged — 50% at signing, 25% at the 12-month mark, 25% at 18 months (flexible to move to 50/50 if needed)
- Effective discount: 17% off list token rate (manager-approved range)
- Credit availability: 30% on signing, then 12.5% quarterly for year 1, 7.5% quarterly for year 2 (keeps credits in play as you scale)
- Signing bonus: 5% top-up credits if Series A closed within 6 months of signing (proof of funding required)
- Minimum monthly floor: begins month 4 at 60% expected consumption; allowances for growth variance in the first 6 months.

Additional commercial notes:
- We can convert leftover credits to platform service credits (non-cash) per your request; Legal will add standard language to the contract.
- Billing/invoicing: we can provide monthly invoices for GAAP.
- If you prefer a shorter vesting cliff but higher upfront availability, we can swap schedules — Karthik will run the cost/usage modeling for two growth scenarios if you send projections.

Next steps: if either option looks good, I can push the termsheet to DocuSign and route for signature. Link (sample): https://docusign.example.com/ENVELOPE12345

Proposed call to finalize: Thu 8/06 9am PT or Fri 8/07 11am PT. Please confirm.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Account Exec | Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123
